name: Glamaur African Kitchen
neighborhoodOrCity: Brooklyn Park (8527 Zane Ave. N., near 85th and Zane)
whatItIs: African restaurant with Nigerian dishes and catering, opened in 2020 by Nigerian immigrant Gladys Eta.
evidence: CCX Media, July 31, 2026, names Eta as owner of Glamaur African Kitchen in Brooklyn Park and says she will serve her dishes at IgboFest 2026; the restaurant's own site offers online ordering.

name: 3D's African Kitchen
neighborhoodOrCity: Crystal (117 Willow Bend, Crystal Shopping Center)
whatItIs: Nigerian and Liberian restaurant opened April 2024 by Kafayat Abodunrin, who came from Nigeria in 2017.
evidence: Opening reported by CCX Media, April 25, 2024; the restaurant's own web address returned an empty page and no 2025 or 2026 dated source was opened.

name: Gidi Bar & Lounge
whatItIs: Lounge founded in 2024 by Nigerian-born Dayo Olateju and team; Afrobeats, hip-hop, Amapiano nights; co-host of Let's Gidi Fest.
evidence: Own site lists events for Oct. 23, 24, 30 and 31 and later dates; Sahan Journal, Aug. 4, 2026, describes the 2026 festival in its parking lot.

name: Bel Curv Management Group
whatItIs: Event production company started by Dayo Olateju; has brought Nigerian Afrobeats artists to Minnesota and co-produces Let's Gidi Fest.
evidence: Sahan Journal, Aug. 4, 2026, reports Bel Curv partnering on the second Let's Gidi Fest, held Aug. 8, 2026. No own website was opened.

name: Nexus of Hope Psychiatry & Mental Health Wellness
whatItIs: Psychiatric practice founded in 2019 by psychiatric nurse practitioner Adejoke Adedeji, who grew up in Nigeria; therapy, medication management, TMS, telehealth.
evidence: A directory listing invites bookings but carries no date; the practice's own website did not respond. MPR News profiled the Lakeville clinic Sept. 15, 2023.

name: The Purposed Parent
type: health and family services (doula, newborn care)
whatItIs: Prenatal, birth and postpartum support company founded in 2022 by Nigerian American sisters Praise and Peace Olowokere, with 12 specialists.
evidence: Minnesota Spokesman-Recorder, June 3, 2026, describes the 12 specialists the company 'currently' employs; own site lists services.

name: Unified Health (assisted living)
whatItIs: Assisted living home built by a Nigerian family, described at its 2021 groundbreaking as care with 'an African touch' for people with mental health needs, brain injury, developmental disabilities and complex medical needs.
evidence: Only the Oct. 29, 2021, groundbreaking report was opened; a guessed company web address did not respond.

name: FIHAN Design + Architecture
whatItIs: Architecture firm founded about 2020 by Nigerian-born architect Wale Falade; 'fihan' is Yoruba for 'to reveal'; selected to redesign North Commons Park.
evidence: Own website is live and describes the practice, but no 2025 or 2026 dated post or report was opened.

name: Zoma House
whatItIs: Studio, event venue and storefront for Black and underrepresented artists, opened in 2026 by Uzoma Ngwu, named from her Igbo first name.
evidence: Minnesota Spokesman-Recorder, Aug. 26, 2026, describes it as having opened earlier in 2026 and hosting events, with city rent support for two years.

name: Zoma Studios
whatItIs: Animation and film studio founded by Uzoma Ngwu before Zoma House.
evidence: Mentioned in the Aug. 26, 2026, Spokesman-Recorder profile as her earlier company; its current activity is not described.
